ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider helpdesk-driven password/MFA reset followed by anomalous-geo Entra sign-in within 60min
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Scattered Spider (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest / 0ktapus) initial-access chain: vishing of an IT helpdesk to force a password or MFA-method reset, immediately followed by an interactive Entra ID sign-in from a country the targeted identity has never used. CISA AA23-320A and Microsoft's Octo Tempest reporting both call this the actor's primary entry vector.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as reset_time values(All_Changes.src) as reset_src values(All_Changes.user) as reset_actor from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where All_Changes.object_category=User All_Changes.action=modified All_Changes.change_type IN ("password","AAA") All_Changes.command IN ("Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password","Update user","User registered security info","Reset user authentication method") by All_Changes.object
| rename All_Changes.object as user
| join type=inner user [
    | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as logon_time values(Authentication.src) as logon_src values(Authentication.src_country) as src_country values(Authentication.app) as app values(Authentication.user_agent) as user_agent from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.signature_id IN ("UserLoggedIn","UserLoginSuccess") (Authentication.app="Microsoft Azure Active Directory" OR Authentication.app="Office 365") by Authentication.user
    | rename Authentication.user as user
]
| where logon_time >= reset_time AND (logon_time - reset_time) <= 3600
| where NOT match(src_country, "(?i)^(US|GB|CA|IE|AU)$")
| eval minutes_since_reset=round((logon_time - reset_time)/60,1)
| table user reset_actor reset_src reset_time logon_src src_country app user_agent logon_time minutes_since_reset
| sort - logon_time
ucs.kql:
// Scattered Spider helpdesk-reset -> anomalous-geo sign-in chain
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowSeconds = 3600;
let HomeCountries = dynamic(["US","GB","CA","IE","AU"]);   // tune to org footprint
let Resets = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("Reset user password.","Reset password (by admin).","Update user.","User registered security info.","Reset user authentication method.")
    | mv-expand ActivityObject = ActivityObjects
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(ActivityObject.Name)), TargetObjectId = tostring(ActivityObject.Id)
    | where TargetUpn has "@"
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, ResetActor = AccountDisplayName, ResetIp = IPAddress, ResetAction = ActionType, TargetUpn;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ErrorCode == 0 and IsInteractive == true
| where Country !in~ (HomeCountries)
| extend AccountUpnLc = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner Resets on $left.AccountUpnLc == $right.TargetUpn
| where Timestamp between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend MinutesSinceReset = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ResetTime)
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, City, UserAgent, Application, DeviceName, ResetTime, ResetAction, ResetActor, ResetIp, MinutesSinceReset
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Scattered Spider helpdesk-reset -> anomalous-geo sign-in chain
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowSeconds = 3600;
let HomeCountries = dynamic(["US","GB","CA","IE","AU"]);
let Resets = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where OperationName in ("Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password","User registered security info","Reset user authentication method","Update user")
    | extend ResetActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), ResetIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | mv-expand TargetResource = TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResource.userPrincipalName))
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, ResetAction = OperationName, ResetActor, ResetIp, TargetUpn;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ResultType == 0 and IsInteractive == true
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), City = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
| where Country !in~ (HomeCountries)
| extend UpnLc = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner Resets on $left.UpnLc == $right.TargetUpn
| where TimeGenerated between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend MinutesSinceReset = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ResetTime)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, City, UserAgent, AppDisplayName, ResetTime, ResetAction, ResetActor, ResetIp, MinutesSinceReset
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Reset password (by admin)" OR "Reset user password" OR "User registered security info" OR "Reset user authentication method") @properties.targetResources.userPrincipalName:*
ucs.rationale: Scattered Spider's hallmark is social-engineering the IT helpdesk into resetting a password or re-enrolling MFA — both Microsoft (Octo Tempest) and CISA AA23-320A flag it as the actor's #1 access pattern. ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider polyglot RMM stack staged on one endpoint (T1219 toolbox)
ucs.description: Hunts for two or more distinct commodity remote-management binaries (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, TeamViewer, RustDesk, Splashtop, ngrok, Fleetdeck, Atera, Action1, Level, Pulseway, LogMeIn) executing on the same host within a 24h window. Scattered Spider is documented by CISA, Mandiant (UNC3944), and Microsoft (Octo Tempest) as deploying multiple RMMs back-to-back so any single tool removed by IT does not sever access.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process_name) as rmm_tools dc(Processes.process_name) as rmm_count values(Processes.process) as cmdlines min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe","rustdesk.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","srservice.exe","ngrok.exe","fleetdeck-agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","syncroservice.exe","atera.agent.exe","ateraagent.exe","action1_agent.exe","action1.exe","level.exe","level-remote.exe","pulseway.exe","logmein.exe","lmiguardiansvc.exe","dwagent.exe","itarianremoteaccess.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user
| where rmm_count >= 2
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval window_minutes=round((last_seen - first_seen)/60,1)
| where window_minutes <= 1440
| where NOT match(user, "\$$")
| table first_seen last_seen window_minutes dest user rmm_count rmm_tools cmdlines
| sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
// Scattered Spider multi-RMM staging on a single host
let RmmTools = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "rustdesk.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","srservice.exe",
    "ngrok.exe","fleetdeck-agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe",
    "syncroservice.exe","atera.agent.exe","ateraagent.exe",
    "action1_agent.exe","action1.exe","level.exe","level-remote.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","logmein.exe","lmiguardiansvc.exe","dwagent.exe","itarianremoteaccess.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(24h)
| where FileName in~ (RmmTools) or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RmmTools)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend RmmName = tolower(iff(FileName in~ (RmmTools), FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName))
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            RmmCount = dcount(RmmName), RmmList = make_set(RmmName),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            DistinctUsers = make_set(AccountName, 10)
            by DeviceName
| where RmmCount >= 2     // >=2 distinct RMM binaries on one host = polyglot toolbox
| extend WindowMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Scattered Spider multi-RMM staging on a single host (ASIM)
let RmmTools = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "rustdesk.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","srservice.exe",
    "ngrok.exe","fleetdeck-agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe",
    "syncroservice.exe","atera.agent.exe","ateraagent.exe",
    "action1_agent.exe","action1.exe","level.exe","level-remote.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","logmein.exe","lmiguardiansvc.exe","dwagent.exe","itarianremoteaccess.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend TargetLc = tolower(TargetProcessName), ActorLc = tolower(ActingProcessName)
| where TargetLc has_any (RmmTools) or ActorLc has_any (RmmTools)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend RmmName = tolower(extract(@"([^\\/]+\.exe)$", 1, iff(TargetLc has_any (RmmTools), TargetProcessName, ActingProcessName)))
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            RmmCount = dcount(RmmName), RmmList = make_set(RmmName),
            SampleCmds = make_set(TargetProcessCommandLine, 25),
            DistinctUsers = make_set(ActorUsername, 10)
            by DvcHostname
| where RmmCount >= 2
| extend WindowMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc

title: Scattered Spider Polyglot RMM Tool Execution
id: 7a4b91e2-cc3f-4f8e-9d2a-1bafac4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of commodity remote-management binaries chained together by Scattered Spider (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest / Muddled Libra) after helpdesk-driven account takeover. Correlate with peer events on the same host to surface the polyglot stack.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026-06-13
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.g1015
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\anydesk.exe'
      - '\screenconnect.clientservice.exe'
      - '\screenconnect.windowsclient.exe'
      - '\connectwisecontrol.client.exe'
      - '\teamviewer.exe'
      - '\rustdesk.exe'
      - '\splashtop.exe'
      - '\sragent.exe'
      - '\ngrok.exe'
      - '\fleetdeck-agent.exe'
      - '\fleetdeckagent.exe'
      - '\syncroservice.exe'
      - '\atera.agent.exe'

      - '\pulseway.exe'
      - '\logmein.exe'
      - '\lmiguardiansvc.exe'
      - '\dwagent.exe'

falsepositives:

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|screenconnect\.clientservice|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.client|teamviewer|tv_(w32|x64)|rustdesk|splashtop|sragent|srservice|ngrok|fleetdeck-?agent|syncroservice|atera\.?agent|action1(_agent)?|level(-remote)?|pulseway|logmein|lmiguardiansvc|dwagent|itarianremoteaccess)\.exe$/i
